Subject: Pemberly Realty Holdings - Quote in Progress

Hi Dana,

Thanks for the submission on Pemberly Realty Holdings! I've received the application, statement of values, and loss runs—everything looks good to move forward.

This risk fits our appetite well. I'm working on putting together competitive terms for the January 3rd effective date and should have a quote to you within the next few business days.

I'll reach out if any questions come up during my review, but at this point, we have what we need to proceed.

Thanks for thinking of us on this one!

Best regards,
[Underwriter name]
